title: EASY CHICKPEA COOKIE / Vegan Weight Loss
description:
EASY CHICKPEA COOKIES 🍪 Healthy Vegan Weight Loss!!

I LOST 60 POUNDS EATING SWEET TREATS JUST LIKE THIS ✨ 

Get all my vegan oil free ebooks for maximum weight loss https://www.broccolimum.com/product-category/ebooks/

These super easy peanut butter cookies are made using chickpeas (of course!) making them high fibre, high protein & so darn delicious!

Ingredients 
1 tin chickpeas, drained
6 medjool dates
1/4 cup peanut butter powder
1 tsp vanilla
Splash of plant milk
1 tsp baking powder
Pinch of salt
Optional - vegan choc chips

1. Blitz all the ingredients in a food processor until it forms a nice cookie dough consistency. Feel free to stop right here and enjoy!
2. Or you can divide into 8 cookies on some parchment paper, add choc chips and pop into the oven at 180 for 20mins. Then enjoy!
